name: BytePlus ModelArk
description: ByteDance's overseas model platform, with a free-token campaign.
overview: BytePlus ModelArk serves ByteDance's Doubao models plus open models through an OpenAI-compatible API. A signup campaign grants free tokens worth a few dollars; campaign terms do not resolve content TTL, training or model-specific routing.
free_access: Free tokens from a signup campaign
notes: Campaign terms do not settle retention or training.
